title: ContractExtraction
description: DESIGN ONLY — not used by the code yet. Planned output of the phase-2 LLM (Groq gpt-oss-120b, response_format json_schema strict) for one Israeli wedding-vendor contract or price quote. Based on docs/PLAN.txt §6, with the additions listed in Future/FUTURE_WORK.txt (signed_on, facebook, instagram; category keys aligned with the real system categories). Amounts are ILS numbers as written in the document; the app converts them to agorot. Strict mode: every property is required and unknown values are null (or [] for lists).

name.description: Trade/brand name as the couple knows it.

website.description: Full URL; add https:// if printed as www.…

facebook.description: Added vs PLAN §6 (the app stores facebookUrl).

instagram.description: Added vs PLAN §6 (the app stores instagramUrl).

category_guess.description: System category key (packages/domain/src/categories.ts). The app has no field for it yet — it would pre-select the category tab.

total.description: ILS as stated. null for per-guest pricing unless a total is printed.

vat.description: included = כולל מע״מ, excluded = + מע״מ / לא כולל, otherwise unknown.

raw_text.description: The price sentence/table as written, for review.

payment_schedule.description: One item per installment, in document order.

amount.description: ILS, only if stated as an amount.

percent.description: Only if stated as a percentage.

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD for a fixed date (DD/MM order in the source).

relative.description: For במעמד החתימה / שבוע לפני האירוע / ביום האירוע …

days_offset.description: Negative = before, 0 = on the day, positive = after.

event_date_in_contract.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the event as stated in the contract — to warn when it differs from the event in the app.

signed_on.description: Added vs PLAN §6: YYYY-MM-DD the contract was signed; anchor for 'N days after signing'.

warnings.description: Hebrew notes on unusual terms: cancellation fees, price increases, overtime, minimum guests, truncated document.
